hematite_spectrum_source.title: splib07a Record=4865: Hematite GDS27                BECKa AREF
hematite_spectrum_source.distribution_note: Source spectrum is not bundled. Title and SHA256 identify the original record; RGB values are derived.

colour_method: CIE tabulated 1931 2 degree/D65,380..780 nm,1 nm; integrate pure pigment then RGB finite KM layer; not full spectral transport

pigment_scattering_length_m.interval_kind: sensitivity support, not measured S uncertainty
pigment_scattering_length_m.evidence_kind: dimensioned model assumption informed by microscopy
pigment_scattering_length_m.conditions: S=1/length for the particulate hematite-clay rim; hematite primary pigment grains 2-3 um, aggregates 50-150 um; applying this length to the clay matrix is a project assumption. Transport mean free path not identified by reflectance alone.

qualification: Only inherited redbed realization. Hematite stock is a conformal particulate shell on host grains. The saved hematite and illite grain_coatings partition is a particulate shell; all other mass remains host. Silica cement uses the same optical host approximation. RGB two-flux layer; spherical representative grains; no smooth film interference; facet Fresnel/lustre retained as uncalibrated host/bulk prior. No fitted colour coordinates or formation identity.
